justification: Both depict a single frontal anthropomorphic figure filling the field, with a marked headdress, body ornaments and a pendant/disc hanging on the chest, and a body surface covered with linear decorative motifs. But the postures and attributes differ sharply — A shows a naturalistically modelled, slender figure with one arm raised aloft grasping a flayed-skin-like object and a mask in the other hand, while B shows a blocky, heavily schematic torso with arms drawn in across the chest and no held objects.
